walsh_mrs.text: Kilkenny sits on the River Nore. If you are quiet by the water, you might spot a Rillotter. Otter droppings smell of jasmine tea, honestly.
There is a tale of the Kilkenny cats, who fought until only their tails were left. We are very proud, and the tails have not been found.
My sister says 'yoke' for everything, and 'banjaxed' for broken. 'The yoke is banjaxed.' It is a full sentence.
